name: Alistair Davies
bio:
Alistair's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for model cars, meticulously painting and customizing them. This passion evolved into an apprenticeship at a local body shop, where he honed his skills in automotive paintwork. His dedication to achieving flawless finishes caught the attention of Aston Martin's racing division, where he's been a valued member of the paint shop team for the past five years.

Alistair's approach to his role is characterized by unwavering attention to detail and a commitment to meeting the exacting standards of Formula 1. He understands the importance of not only aesthetics but also the aerodynamic properties of the paint finish. Known for his ability to troubleshoot even the most complex paint issues, Alistair is a meticulous perfectionist who takes immense pride in his craft. His lone wolf approach allows him to focus intently on his work, delivering consistently high-quality results under pressure.

What sets Alistair apart is his innovative approach to problem-solving. He's always exploring new techniques and materials to enhance the durability and performance of the paint finishes. While he prefers to work independently, Alistair is always willing to share his expertise with colleagues, contributing to a culture of continuous improvement within the team.
